passage:
During online class, some students turned their cameras on, while others kept them off. A teacher wanted everyone visible, but students gave different reasons.
One had a weak internet connection. Another shared a room with younger brothers. A third felt nervous being watched on screen all day.
The teacher changed the rule. Cameras were needed for short discussions, but students could turn them off during quiet work. They could also answer with chat messages.
The class became more comfortable and more active.
Online learning taught the teacher that participation does not always look the same. A dark screen may hide laziness, but it may also hide a real problem.
